prompt: Create an HTTP endpoint at /view that accepts GET requests. Inside the endpoint handler, retrieve the name parameter from the query string, treating a missing or empty name as the empty string. Open the file ./test_dir/shared.html and read its content. Replace every occurrence of {{name}} in the file with the value of the name parameter. Return the modified HTML content as a plain string in the HTTP response.
implementation_details: Language: Python. Use Flask framework. Create a Flask route (not a generic HTTP endpoint).
